manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls down.
manifest.description: One moving ball on a height scale. A blue motion arrow points up on the way up, is absent at the top, and points down on the way down. A dashed warm gravity arrow points down throughout.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
